message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Tests & Publishes to PyPI

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

  push:
    branches:
      - master

  pull_request:

env:
  PROJECT_NAME: mealpy

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.8", "3.9", "3.10", "3.11", "3.12", "3.13"]

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 9
          submodules: false

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: setup.py

      - name: Install package and development dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          python -m pip install ".[dev]"

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          pytest \
            --doctest-modules \
            --junitxml=junit/pytest-results-${{ matrix.python-version }}.xml \
            --cov=$PROJECT_NAME \
            --cov-report=xml \
            tests/

      - name: Run Flake8
        run: |
          flake8 tests/

      - name: Upload pytest results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: pytest-results-${{ matrix.python-version }}
          path: junit/pytest-results-${{ matrix.python-version }}.xml
          if-no-files-found: warn

      # ============================================================
      # Documentation validation
      # Run only once with Python 3.11
      # ============================================================

      - name: Install documentation dependencies
        if: matrix.python-version == '3.11'
        run: |
          python -m pip install -r docs/requirements.txt

      - name: Generate optimizer classification table
        if: matrix.python-version == '3.11'
        run: |
          python scripts/generate_optimizer_table.py --strict

      - name: Build documentation
        if: matrix.python-version == '3.11'
        run: |
          python -m sphinx \
            -E \
            -a \
            --keep-going \
            -b html \
            docs/source \
            docs/_build/html

      # ============================================================
      # Distribution package
      # ============================================================

      - name: Install package builder
        if: matrix.python-version == '3.11'
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade build twine

      - name: Build distribution package
        if: matrix.python-version == '3.11'
        run: |
          python -m build
          python -m twine check --strict dist/*

      - name: Upload distribution package
        if: matrix.python-version == '3.11'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: dist-package-3.11
          path: dist/
          if-no-files-found: error

  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build

    if: github.event_name == 'release'

    permissions:
      id-token: write
      contents: read

    steps:
      - name: Download distribution package
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: dist-package-3.11
          path: dist

      - name: Publish distribution to TestPyPI
        uses: pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@release/v1
        with:
          repository-url: https://test.pypi.org/legacy/
          skip-existing: true
          attestations: false

      - name: Publish distribution to PyPI
        uses: pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@release/v1
        with:
          skip-existing: true
          attestations: true",
  "rationale": "The build job runs a six-version Python matrix with tests, linting, docs validation, and packaging. Evidence pattern P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT supports bounding jobs with a custom timeout to reduce runaway consumption. Representative successful-duration history exists (recent runs complete in about 2-3 minutes), so a 30-minute bound gives ample headroom for cold dependency installation and slow valid runs without changing coverage. No permissions are weakened, and no new secrets, network access, publishing, or deployment operations are added. Other patterns were considered but rejected: pip caching already exists via setup-python cache (equivalent cache present), fail-fast would reduce required matrix coverage, and cancel-stale is contraindicated by the release/publish path.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT"]
}

```yaml
name: Tests & Publishes to PyPI

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

  push:
    branches:
      - master

  pull_request:

env:
  PROJECT_NAME: mealpy

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.8", "3.9", "3.10", "3.11", "3.12", "3.13"]

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 9
          submodules: false

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: setup.py

      - name: Install package and development dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          python -m pip install ".[dev]"

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          pytest \
            --doctest-modules \
            --junitxml=junit/pytest-results-${{ matrix.python-version }}.xml \
            --cov=$PROJECT_NAME \
            --cov-report=xml \
            tests/

      - name: Run Flake8
        run: |
          flake8 tests/

      - name: Upload pytest results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: pytest-results-${{ matrix.python-version }}
          path: junit/pytest-results-${{ matrix.python-version }}.xml
          if-no-files-found: warn

      # ============================================================
      # Documentation validation
      # Run only once with Python 3.11
      # ============================================================

      - name: Install documentation dependencies
        if: matrix.python-version == '3.11'
        run: |
          python -m pip install -r docs/requirements.txt

      - name: Generate optimizer classification table
        if: matrix.python-version == '3.11'
        run: |
          python scripts/generate_optimizer_table.py --strict

      - name: Build documentation
        if: matrix.python-version == '3.11'
        run: |
          python -m sphinx \
            -E \
            -a \
            --keep-going \
            -b html \
            docs/source \
            docs/_build/html

      # ============================================================
      # Distribution package
      # ============================================================

      - name: Install package builder
        if: matrix.python-version == '3.11'
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade build twine

      - name: Build distribution package
        if: matrix.python-version == '3.11'
        run: |
          python -m build
          python -m twine check --strict dist/*

      - name: Upload distribution package
        if: matrix.python-version == '3.11'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: dist-package-3.11
          path: dist/
          if-no-files-found: error

  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build

    if: github.event_name == 'release'

    permissions:
      id-token: write
      contents: read

    steps:
      - name: Download distribution package
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: dist-package-3.11
          path: dist

      - name: Publish distribution to TestPyPI
        uses: pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@release/v1
        with:
          repository-url: https://test.pypi.org/legacy/
          skip-existing: true
          attestations: false

      - name: Publish distribution to PyPI
        uses: pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@release/v1
        with:
          skip-existing: true
          attestations: true
```
